review_scope: Existing passed GUI-normal report, source/strict receipts, and pinned driver source; no runtime execution, rerun, ELF hashing, screenshot review, or private-home scan performed.

strict_receipt.reaped_entry_meaning: Only the command, with returncode zero; not an independent inventory of all GUI descendants.

pinned_source_review.browser: Playwright Chromium fallback; not in-app Browser
pinned_source_review.both_cycles: Actual manager/desktop and native App Server, persisted history, native file-search exercise, completed file-reference turn, incremental streaming, then first-SIGINT manager shutdown while a model invocation is positively held.
pinned_source_review.cycle_1_only: One Allow once approval with completed native command and output; one UI Stop with interrupted model absence and settled controls; one browser reload; one completed continuation turn.
pinned_source_review.cycle_2_recovery: Cold-engine restart after cycle-1 drain, with interrupted task state recovered.
pinned_source_review.search: Built-in native fuzzyFileSearch; no independently selected search component in this passed run. Nine behaviors exercised per cycle: real filesystem results, relative-root rejection, click insertion, keyboard insertion, draft preservation, A-B-A query fence, root replacement fence, explicit close fence, task replacement fence. Held responses come from actual route.fetch; result bodies are unchanged.
pinned_source_review.installed_package_evidence: Driver compares fingerprints of every regular file beneath installed component objects before and after, and reports installed_packages_unchanged=true. It separately verifies the independent package files and selected storage worker pin. The GUI report does not serialize the complete package fingerprint inventory; this review did not scan private homes.

limits: Shutdown seconds measure manager SIGINT to manager wait completion, not total descendant cleanup.
Process absence covers observed descendant identities plus child-subreaper drainage; sampling can miss short-lived descendants.
Browser automation assertions were reviewed; screenshots were not reviewed.
Some negative UI search checks use bounded observation windows; this is not a universal race proof.
This run does not prove installed-search behavior, live-provider behavior, individual constructor receipts, all transport closure, or completion of all P03 gates.
Failed GUI-search diagnosis is outside this review.
